# Architecture: BookShelf

Component view of the ASP.NET Core MVC app, from `profile.json` (`structure.key_dirs`, `stack`, `entities`).

```mermaid
flowchart LR
    Browser["Browser"] --> Program["Program.cs<br/>routing and services"]
    Program --> Home["HomeController"]
    Program --> Account["AccountController"]
    Program --> Books["BooksController"]
    Home --> Views["Razor views<br/>Views/"]
    Account --> Views
    Books --> Views
    Books --> Db["AppDbContext<br/>Data/"]
    Db --> Sql[("SQL Server")]
    Db -.->|"DbSet"| Models["Book, User, Review<br/>Models/"]
```

Notes:
- `AccountController` does not use `AppDbContext` yet: its login and register handlers do not read or write data (see the risks in `profile.json`).
- `Review` is mapped by the DbContext but no controller uses it.
